def next_permutation(nums: list[int]) -> None:
    n = len(nums)
    i = n - 2
    while i >= 0 and nums[i] >= nums[i + 1]:
        i -= 1                       # find the pivot left of the descending tail
    if i >= 0:
        j = n - 1
        while nums[j] <= nums[i]:
            j -= 1                   # rightmost value larger than the pivot
        nums[i], nums[j] = nums[j], nums[i]
    lo, hi = i + 1, n - 1
    while lo < hi:                   # turn the tail into its smallest order
        nums[lo], nums[hi] = nums[hi], nums[lo]
        lo += 1
        hi -= 1

def can_complete_circuit(gas: list[int], cost: list[int]) -> int:
    total = 0          # net fuel over the whole circle
    tank = 0           # net fuel since the current candidate start
    start = 0
    for i in range(len(gas)):
        delta = gas[i] - cost[i]
        total += delta
        tank += delta
        if tank < 0:
            # No stop in [start, i] can be a valid start.
            start = i + 1
            tank = 0
    return start if total >= 0 else -1

        node.next = copy.next

        max_count = max(max_count, counts[c])
